shared_elements: central disc / concentric circle motif placed on the middle of the field
curvilinear relief motifs (loops, hooks, spiral-like forms)
horizontal band(s) crossing the surface below the central disc
roughly bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
paired motifs flanking a central element
justification: Both surfaces place a concentric disc/ring at the centre of a bilaterally symmetric field with paired curvilinear motifs flanking it and horizontal banding below, which is the most specific correspondence but also a very common compositional habit. The depicted content otherwise diverges sharply: A is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, headdress and body whose sparse, blocky low-relief signs read as garment or body ornament, while B is a flat panel wholly filled with elaborate interlaced spiral and serpentine ornament and no figural body at all.
